source_extracts.label: USPS Notice 11 — Tips for Postal Customers with Centralized Mailboxes
source_extracts.quote: If you've lost or misplaced your mailbox key, ask the owner, manager, or superintendent of your apartment or home for a replacement. You shouldn't pry open your mailbox, because it's against the law, and also because our carriers can't deliver mail to unlocked or unsecured boxes.

source_extracts.label: USPS Notice 11 — unsecured box suspension
source_extracts.quote: It's against Postal Service policy to deliver mail to unlocked or unsecured mailboxes. We want to protect you by protecting the privacy of your mail. If your mailbox is unsecured, delivery service may be suspended until your box is repaired. In the meantime, you can pick up your mail at your local Post Office™.

source_extracts.label: USPS FAQ — Locked Mailboxes and Mailbox Keys (duplicate keys / lost key)
source_extracts.quote: Duplicate Keys: The Postal Service keeps no duplicate keys and if the customer loses all the keys, the Postal Service will have to install a new lock and issue a new set of keys at the customer's expense. Note: There is no established fee; this charge is based on local costs.

source_extracts.label: USPS FAQ — Lost, stolen, or broken key routing
source_extracts.quote: My Mailbox Key has been Lost, Stolen, or Broken: You will need to verify whether or not the mailboxes at your residential building (e.g. apartment, condominium, etc.) are owned and maintained by the United States Postal Service. For only those boxes that are maintained by the USPS: Please contact your local Post Office facility for assistance. For all other mailboxes: Please speak with your residential building owner or manager, as they are responsible for purchasing, installing, and maintaining mailboxes.

source_extracts.label: USPS FAQ — private mailboxes
source_extracts.quote: Note: The United States Postal Service is not able to help you access mailboxes owned and maintained by private residential building complexes.

source_extracts.label: Mailbox Plus Source of Truth §4 — PMB key deposit and terms
source_extracts.quote: Key deposit: $5.00 refundable when you cancel and return the key. Contract / commitment wording: "Month-to-month, no term commitment, cancel anytime".

source_extracts.label: Mailbox Plus Source of Truth §4 — package receiving and hold fees
source_extracts.quote: Package Receiving: Offered for both mailbox holders and non-holders. Non-holder walk-in package receiving fee is $10.00/package; PMB holder overage beyond plan allowance is $5.00/package. Long-hold storage: Held longer than 5 days = $1.00/package/day.

PMB addresses must use '#' or 'PMB', never 'Suite' (store_facts banned-pmb-suite-format).
